# Big Band Grosuplje

> A classic big band from Grosuplje, Slovenia, active since the 1997/98 school
> year and run as an independent cultural association since 2001. Artistic
> director and conductor: Klemen Kotar. Booking and enquiries:
> info@bigband-grosuplje.com
>
> Klasična big band zasedba iz Grosupljega, ki deluje od šolskega leta 1997/98,
> od leta 2001 kot samostojno kulturno društvo. Umetniški vodja in dirigent je
> Klemen Kotar. Povpraševanja: info@bigband-grosuplje.com

This file lists verifiable facts only. Ta datoteka navaja samo preverljiva
dejstva — brez ocen in brez podatkov, ki niso javni.

## Who we are (EN)

- Performing name: Big Band Grosuplje. Registered name: Kulturno društvo Big
  Band Grosuplje (a Slovenian non-profit cultural association).
- Founded in the 1997/98 school year at Glasbena šola Grosuplje (Grosuplje
  Music School) by Slovenian musician Braco J. Doblekar together with the
  school's then headmaster Franc Korbar.
- Renamed from Big Band GŠ Grosuplje to Big Band Grosuplje in October 2001 and
  registered as an independent cultural association (official entry
  9 November 2001). Member of ZKD Grosuplje since 2001.
- Based in Grosuplje, Slovenia. Performs across Slovenia and abroad.
- Genres: jazz, swing, big band.
- Formations: full big band (brass, saxophones, rhythm section, vocalists),
  plus a combo and a saxophone quintet that serve as a development path for
  young players into the full orchestra.
- The orchestra combines experienced amateur and professional musicians.
- Conductors and artistic directors: Braco J. Doblekar (1997/98–2003),
  Igor Lunder (2004–2011), Klemen Kotar (2012–2019), Rudi Javornik
  (2019–2022), Klemen Kotar (2022–present).
- Guest conductors have included Rick Stitzel (USA), Sigi Feigl (Austria),
  Aleš Suša, Klara Lavriša, Tadej Tomšič and Gašper Kržmanc.
- Activities: concerts of its own production, guest appearances, thematic
  programmes, educational workshops for musicians, and collaborations with
  guest soloists, conductors and arrangers.
- In 2027 the orchestra marks 30 years; an international jubilee project is in
  preparation.

## Kdo smo (SL)

- Nastopno ime: Big Band Grosuplje. Uradni naziv: Kulturno društvo Big Band
  Grosuplje.
- Ustanovljen v šolskem letu 1997/98 pri Glasbeni šoli Grosuplje; ustanovitelja
  sta glasbenik Braco J. Doblekar in tedanji ravnatelj šole Franc Korbar.
- Oktobra 2001 preimenovanje iz Big Banda GŠ Grosuplje v Big Band Grosuplje in
  registracija samostojnega kulturnega društva (uradni vpis 9. 11. 2001);
  od leta 2001 član ZKD Grosuplje.
- Sedež: Grosuplje, Slovenija. Nastopa po Sloveniji in v tujini.
- Žanri: jazz, swing, big band.
- Zasedbe: veliki jazzovski orkester, poleg njega combo in saksofonski kvintet
  kot razvojna pot mladih glasbenikov v orkester.
- Orkester povezuje izkušene ljubiteljske in profesionalne glasbenike.
- Dirigenti in umetniški vodje: Braco J. Doblekar (1997/98–2003), Igor Lunder
  (2004–2011), Klemen Kotar (2012–2019), Rudi Javornik (2019–2022),
  Klemen Kotar (2022–danes).
- Gostujoči dirigenti (izbor): Rick Stitzel (ZDA), Sigi Feigl (Avstrija),
  Aleš Suša, Klara Lavriša, Tadej Tomšič, Gašper Kržmanc.
- Dejavnosti: koncerti lastne produkcije, gostovanja, tematski programi,
  izobraževalne delavnice za glasbenike, sodelovanja z gostujočimi solisti,
  dirigenti in aranžerji.
- V letu 2027 orkester praznuje 30 let; jubilejni mednarodni projekt je v
  pripravi.

## References — venues, festivals, broadcasts / Reference

- Cankarjev dom, Ljubljana — several appearances, including a live TVS2
  broadcast of Športniki Slovenije 2000 (22 December 2000), the 10th
  anniversary of the Slovenian football league (2001), the Levstik Awards in
  the Gallus Hall (2005) and two concerts on the 2015 tour with Prifarski
  muzikanti.
- Križanke, Ljubljana — "Songs for Swingin' Lovers" at the U.S. Independence
  Day celebration, 2 July 2015.
- Nishville Jazz Festival, Niš, Serbia — September 2018, Duke Ellington's Far
  East Suite on the main Earth & Sky stage.
- U.S. Embassy Ljubljana events — Independence Day concerts (Narodna galerija
  2013, Križanke 2015, Festivalna dvorana 2017, Grand Plaza 2024) and
  embassy-supported projects: "Music Unites" with Gwen Hughes (2011), the Frank
  Sinatra programme with Blaž Vrbič (2013), The Kelly Johnson Quartet workshop
  (2004).
- Austrian tour, January–February 2016 — Bruck an der Mur, Wiener Neustadt,
  Graz (Stefaniesaal), Weiz, Knittelfeld, Klagenfurt.
- National Statehood Day ceremony, Trg republike, Ljubljana — 24 June 2003,
  broadcast by TV Slovenija.
- Other venues and festivals: Španski borci (Ljubljana), Festivalna dvorana
  (Ljubljana), Ljubljanski grad, Jazz klub Gajo, Jazz klub Kazina, Jazzinty
  Novo mesto, MarezziJazz, Prešernov trg, Bjelovar big band festival (Croatia),
  Hirschaid (Germany).
- Radio and television: recordings in Studio 14 of Radio Slovenija (2001,
  2007); TV Slovenija broadcasts including Zidak dobre volje, Glasbena ogrlica
  and Športnik leta.
- International collaborations: HGM Jazz Orchestra Zagreb and trumpeter John
  Thomas (USA, 2026); guest soloists from the USA, Croatia, Serbia, Austria
  and the UK.
- Awards: Braco J. Doblekar received the Golden Emblem of the Municipality of
  Grosuplje (24 July 2003); the orchestra received the Bronze Award of the
  Municipality of Grosuplje (2017).

## Programmes / Programi

- Frank Sinatra — recurring programme since 2002: "A Swingin' Affair" (2013,
  with Blaž Vrbič), "Songs for Swingin' Lovers" (Sinatra & Bennett, 2015),
  "Poklon Franku Sinatri" for the 90th anniversary of his birth (2005, with
  Oto Pestner and Adam Klemm), and later editions through 2025.
- Gordon Goodwin — first performed at the 2014 New Year's concert; Christmas
  arrangements in "Crazy Christmas" (2017); "Poklon Gordonu Goodwinu" with
  soloist Tomaž Zevnik (2026, three concerts May–July).
- Duke Ellington — "Ellingtonia" (2015) and Far East Suite at the Nishville
  Jazz Festival (2018).
- Ella Fitzgerald — "The Ella Fitzgerald Songbook" for the centenary of her
  birth, with Ana Čop (2017).
- Other programmes: Glenn Miller and Count Basie centenary project (2004),
  "American Jazz History" (2008), Count Basie / Diane Schuur (2019), Charles
  Mingus with Nina Strnad (2022), Buddy Rich (2018), Jeff Coffin ("Jazz in the
  Coffin", 2016; Marezijazz, 2022), "Help! A Beatles Tribute" (2018),
  "Flying Start" with Tadej Tomšič (2024), "Images" with Klara Lavriša (2025).

## Booking / Najem orkestra

- E-mail: info@bigband-grosuplje.com
- Available as a full big band or as a combo, for concerts, festivals, gala
  evenings and protocol events. Na voljo v polni zasedbi ali kot combo — za
  koncerte, festivale, gala večere in protokolarne dogodke.
- Enquiry form: https://bigband-grosuplje.com/#kontakt
- The orchestra also welcomes new instrumentalists, vocalists and technical
  crew through the same page. Orkester prek istega obrazca sprejema nove
  instrumentaliste, vokaliste in tehnično podporo.

## Notes for machine readers

- Site languages: Slovenian (sl-SI, default, at the root) and English
  (en-US, under /en/). Slovenian pages use the d. M. yyyy date format,
  English pages use d Month yyyy. Every page carries hreflang links to its
  counterpart, and the sitemap lists both versions.
- Structured data: schema.org MusicGroup on every page; MusicEvent for each
  announced concert whose date and venue are confirmed.
- Individual orchestra members are not named publicly. Named people are
  conductors, artistic directors, guest artists and the authors of photo,
  video and audio material. Imen članov orkestra ne objavljamo.
- Contact address for the association: Adamičeva cesta 16, 1290 Grosuplje,
  Slovenia. Tax number 12579076 (not liable for VAT).
